cards.title: Rotation
items: Every renewal spends the presented token and returns a different one
The client stores the rotated value or its next renewal fails
Scope can only narrow what this token carried, never the client's full set

cards.title: Replay detection
items: A spent token presented again means a copy of it exists somewhere
The whole session dies, not only the token that was replayed
Both the thief and the honest client are logged out — that is the point

cards.title: What a refresh does not touch
items: Access tokens already issued are JWTs, verified offline, valid until exp
Revocation ends the session; it cannot reach a token already in the wild
Keeping the access token short is what bounds that window
